caption_ko: 황토색의 작은 신경세포가 밝은 기존 뉴런의 가지 사이로 뻗고, 확대 원에는 성장 중인 끝과 이웃 가지 사이의 틈이 보인다. 국소적 신경 생성 뒤 적절한 회로에 참여해야 하는 과제를 표현한 청사진·잉크풍 AI 생성 개념 일러스트다.
caption_en: A small ochre neuron extends among the pale branches of mature neurons; a magnified view shows a growing tip and a gap to a neighboring process. This cyanotype-and-ink-inspired AI-generated conceptual illustration evokes the challenge of joining an appropriate circuit after local neurogenesis.
alt_ko: 짙은 청색 바탕의 밝은 성숙 뉴런들 사이에서 작은 황토색 뉴런이 가느다란 가지를 뻗고, 오른쪽 위 확대 원이 성장 끝과 이웃 가지 사이의 틈을 보여준다.
alt_en: A small ochre neuron extends slender processes among pale mature neurons on a deep blue field; an upper-right magnified circle shows a growing tip and the gap to a neighboring process.

art_reference.principle: Luminous pale branching forms against a chemically textured blue field, with careful edges and layered spaces; transformed into a new neuronal microenvironment.

self_review: Actual new PNG inspected. Cells have distinct bodies and branching processes, with one smaller ochre young neuron and freely ending growing processes.
The magnified tip approaches but does not fuse with the neighboring process. This is a conceptual local microenvironment, not a measured synapse map or repair result.
At320x180 the young ochre cell and surrounding pale branches remain visible; close viewing reveals spines, terminal shapes and print grain.
In grayscale the ochre color cue disappears, but the smaller cell and its sparser processes remain identifiable; the caption/alt preserves its intended role.
No clinical improvement, treatment outcome or completed restoration is depicted. Publication/mobile/PDF and independent scientific checks remain with the publication workflow.
postprocess: Original generated PNG unchanged; companion preview WebP is format encoding only. Final exact16:9 publication encoding is handled separately.

independent_cover_review.result: accepted after direct final PNG and bilingual caption/alt inspection
independent_cover_review.scope: qualitative scientific and artistic cover review; not reader experiment or deployment verification
